name: std::atomic_notify_all
intro:
Performs atomic notifying operations.

Unblocks all threads blocked in atomic waiting operations (i.e. std::atomic_wait(), std::atomic_wait_explicit(), or std::atomic::wait()) on *object, if there are any; otherwise does nothing.

Equivalent to object->notify_all().

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
object

 -

 pointer to the atomic object to notify

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This form of change-detection is often more efficient than simple polling or pure spinlocks.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: The free functions wait for a shared value to change from 0 to 42.
